item.title: Watch Abu Dhabi’s Asian Le Mans Series doubleheader season finale live this weekend on RACER Network
item.description: The 2025-26 Asian Le Mans Series season finale will be held in Abu Dhabi, with all three titles to be decided at the Yas Marina Circuit in a pair of races on Saturday and Sunday, Feb. 7-8.

item.title: Rolex 24 results confirmed
item.description: The results of the 64th Rolex 24 At Daytona are now official, with no changes, following an extended technical inspection of the top four cars in each class.

item.title: Inside the SCCA: Behind the scenes at the Super Tour
item.description: In this episode of Inside the SCCA, Brian Bielanski sits down with Scott Dolbler, SCCA Racing series manager and the man who literally drives the Super Tour across America. item.title: Inside the making of NHRA’s ‘Chasing Speed’ docuseries
item.description: NHRA is ushering in its 75th anniversary season with a new docuseries that hopefully will help fans see the sport in a new light.

item.title: Formula E confirms Evo Sessions line-up and event format
item.description: The full line-up and format for Formula E’s Evo Sessions influencer event has been revealed, with two teams of the internet’s most followed personalities set to go head-to-head at the Jeddah Corniche Circuit after next week’s Jeddah E-Prix.

item.title: IndyCar weighing options with clock ticking on PREMA
item.description: With a paddock-wide test in place for Monday and Tuesday at Sebring’s short course, an official test on the Phoenix oval the following week, and opening practice for the first race of the season just three weeks away at St. Petersburg, the clock is ticking for PREMA to fill the 26th and 27th grid positions for the IndyCar Series.

item.title: Rolex 24 At Daytona sets multiple records for IMSA
item.description: Along with attendance records, according to NBC, its network coverage drew over 1.1 million viewers, with its Sunday race finale window delivering a 49 percent improvement from 2025.

item.title: Crowdstrike by APR closes on Asian Le Mans Series title with 1-2 in Abu Dhabi
item.description: The No. 4 Crowdstrike Racing by APR ORECA-Gibson team made it three wins in a row in the Asian Le Mans Series at the opening race of the season finale doubleheader in Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Father-son Summers team takes one-two in King of the Hammers Everyman Challenge
item.description: Dylan and Derek Summers took the top two places in the Yokohama Everyman Challenge at the King of the Hammers.
